entities.summary: Brave's Congress, a political institution in Poland during Piast Dynasty & Christianisation (992–1138). Grew from Baptism of Poland (966) — Mieszko I adopts Christianity and Mieszko I & Baptism of Poland. Led to the emergence of Bolesław the Brave & Early Kingdom.
